the molecular genetic analysis of a locus that affects the phenotype of the juvenile cystic mouse.
the genetic analysis of modifying genes that affect the severity of polystic kidney disease.
the molecular genetic analysis of PKD in the jck mouse and its application to the identification of genes involved in the pathogenesis of human autosomal recessive PKD.

the severity of PKD in the jck mouse is affected by a locus on chromosome 1, which may be influenced by other modifying loci.

there are two loci on chromosome 1 that contribute to disease severity in the jck mouse.

genetic analysis of complex traits is not straightforward and that the use of congenic strains may lead to erroneous conclusions if the phenotype is caused by multiple linked loci.
